did_you_know.title: Nat Turner leads black slaves and free blacks in a rebellion in Southampton Coun…
did_you_know.text: Nat Turner leads black slaves and free blacks in a rebellion in Southampton County, Virginia, which will claim the lives of 55 to 65 whites and about twice that number of blacks.

did_you_know.title: Enslaved Africans in Saint-Domingue, led by Dutty Boukman, held a Vodou ceremony…
did_you_know.text: Enslaved Africans in Saint-Domingue, led by Dutty Boukman, held a Vodou ceremony that became a pivotal act of resistance. This gathering sparked a mass uprising against slavery, marking the beginning of the Haitian Revolution.
